answer: Resist Sybils with net-mender's mesh knots. At the jetty, a newcomer spends 22 days mending 28 nets, and two menders from different docks pull-test all 200 knots on each one, writing every result on a timber board. More than 5 slipped knots voids that net's credit and pauses mending for 10 days; 3 slipped nets void the whole count. A passed net earns a crystal seal that rings clear when tapped, a sound no copy can fake. Faking 1,000 agents needs 28,000 nets and 56,000 dock tests in 22 days. Like a jetty that only moors boats it has tied, trust holds knot by knot.
